mind_map.root_node: Shapes and Patterns (Tessellations, Polygons, Tangrams & 3D Nets)

key_nodes: Tessellation Definition: Covering a 2D plane completely using repeating geometric tiles without gaps or overlaps
Vertex Fitting Condition: Interior angles of meeting tile corners at any vertex must sum to exactly 360°
Tessellating Shapes: Squares (90° x 4 = 360°), Rectangles, Regular Hexagons (120° x 3 = 360°), Equilateral Triangles (60° x 6 = 360°)
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Believing any regular polygon can tile a plane seamlessly without checking interior angle sums at vertices.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Tessellation Vertex Rule: Sum of meeting corner angles = 360°.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Bathroom floor tiling, honeycomb structures, and Rajasthani brick wall patterns.

key_nodes: Non-Tessellating Shapes: Circles, Regular Pentagons (108° cannot divide 360° evenly, leaving 24° gaps)
Composite Tiling: Combining 2 or more shape types to fill 360° vertices (e.g., octagons + squares)
Irregular Tiling: Hand-drawn irregular interlocking tiles (Escher-style motifs)
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Assuming regular pentagons tessellate because they are symmetrical polygons.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Gap Identification: 360° - Sum(Corner Angles) > 0 indicates non-tessellating gaps.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Pavement brick design and artistic parquet flooring.

key_nodes: Polygon Definition: Closed 2D plane figure made entirely of straight line segments
Triangles by Side Properties: Equilateral (3 equal sides, all 60°), Isosceles (2 equal sides), Scalene (3 different side lengths)
Quadrilaterals (4 Sides): Square, Rectangle, Rhombus (4 equal sides), Parallelogram (opposite sides parallel/equal), Trapezium
Higher Polygons: Pentagon (5 sides), Hexagon (6 sides), Octagon (8 sides)
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Classifying a rotated square as a 'diamond' or rhombus without verifying if angles are right angles.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Polygon Side Hierarchy: N-sided closed figure has N vertices and N interior angles.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Architectural truss design, sign board classification, and mosaic art.

key_nodes: Tangram Composition: 5 Triangles (2 large, 1 medium, 2 small), 1 Square, 1 Parallelogram
Area Preservation: Rearranging pieces forms diverse animal/human silhouettes with identical total surface area
Spatial Reasoning: Combining 2 small triangles to form the square or medium triangle
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Overlapping tangram pieces when creating puzzle target shapes.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Tangram Area Conservation: Sum of 7 individual piece areas = Area of outer bounding square.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Creative spatial puzzle solving, logo design, and floor tile mosaics.

key_nodes: 3D Net Definition: Flat 2D pattern of polygon faces that folds into a closed 3D solid figure
Cube Net: 6 identical square faces connected along edges (11 distinct valid folding nets exist)
Prism & Pyramid Nets: Triangular prisms, square-based pyramids unfolded flat
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Assuming any 6-square shape forms a cube net (overlapping faces occur if edges are misjoined).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Net Validation: A net must fold cleanly along shared edges without overlapping faces.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Cardboard packaging box manufacture and sheet metal fabrication.

key_nodes: Regular Dodecahedron: 12 pentagonal faces; Regular Icosahedron: 20 triangular faces
Euler's Polyhedron Formula: F + V - E = 2 (Valid for all convex polyhedra)
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Counting edges twice when inspecting 3D solid models.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Euler's Polyhedron Formula: Faces + Vertices - Edges = 2 (F + V - E = 2).
sub_branches.real_world_application: Geodesic dome construction, 3D computer graphics modeling, and crystallography.
